DataSource.query:
begin 
SELECT prv.[FLAG_CUSTOMER_INTERCOMPANY] as flagic
      ,substring(cast(prv.[SEQ_DAY] as varchar(8)), 1, 4) as annee
	  ,substring(cast(prv.[SEQ_DAY] as varchar(8)), 5, 2) as mois
      ,soc.COD_COMPANY as origin_company
      ,concat('MOD-', md.COD_PRODUCT_MODEL) as model
      ,alloc.ID_ALLOCATION as allocation 
      ,sum(prv.[AMT_FORECAST]) as prev
	  ,sum(prv.[QTY_forecast]) as qtym
  FROM [KUHN_BI_DWH].[ACCOUNTING].[FACT_FORECAST] prv
  left outer join [KUHN_BI_DWH].common.dim_company soc on prv.SEQ_SOURCE_COMPANY = soc.SEQ_COMPANY
  left outer join [KUHN_BI_DWH].common.DIM_CUSTOMER_COGNOS cust on prv.SEQ_CUSTOMER_COGNOS = cust.SEQ_CUSTOMER_COGNOS
  left outer join [KUHN_BI_DWH].common.DIM_PRODUCT_MODEL md on prv.SEQ_PRODUCT_MODEL = md.SEQ_PRODUCT_MODEL
  left outer join [KUHN_BI_DWH].common.DIM_ALLOCATION alloc on prv.SEQ_ALLOCATION = alloc.SEQ_ALLOCATION
  where prv.SEQ_DAY >= year(getdate()) * 10000 + 101
  group by 
  prv.[FLAG_CUSTOMER_INTERCOMPANY], 
  substring(cast(prv.[SEQ_DAY] as varchar(8)), 1, 4), 
  substring(cast(prv.[SEQ_DAY] as varchar(8)), 5, 2),
  soc.COD_COMPANY,
  md.COD_PRODUCT_MODEL,
  alloc.ID_ALLOCATION
end
